instruction: Sort the data in the spreadsheet by the Date Time column in ascending order (earliest to latest).

metadata.explanation: Task requires sorting data by Date Time in ascending order. Verified with Python that the earliest dates have products 'Fun Fly' (2014-12-06) and 'Carlota Doublers' (2014-12-07). Evaluator checks cells C2 and C3 contain these product names.

llm_judge_reasons: Incomplete coverage: Only checks 2 cells (C2, C3) to verify sorting of entire dataset
Checking only the first two rows after sorting does not verify that ALL rows are sorted in ascending order by Date Time
Edge cases not handled: Partial sorts, incorrect ordering in later rows, or duplicate dates would not be detected
The instruction requires verifying the entire dataset is sorted, but evaluator only validates the top 2 entries
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add checks for multiple strategic rows throughout the dataset (e.g., check rows at positions 25%, 50%, 75%, 100% to verify sort order is maintained)
Check at least 5-10 rows across the dataset to ensure Date Time values are in ascending order
Alternatively, compare the entire result file against a pre-sorted expected file using sheet_data comparison
Add verification that Date Time column values are monotonically increasing across checked rows
